metrics.name: Course Completion Rate
metrics.description_hint: % of users who started and completed a course.
metrics.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN {event_col} = '{end_event}' THEN {user_col} END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN {event_col} = '{start_event}' THEN {user_col} END), 0), 1) AS course_completion_rate_pct FROM {table}

metrics.name: Weekly Learning Users
metrics.description_hint: Unique users active in learning events in a 7-day window.
metrics.sql_template: SELECT DATE({time_col}) AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT {user_col}) AS wlu FROM {table} WHERE {event_col} = '{matched_event}' AND DATE({time_col}) BETWEEN DATE(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 days') AND CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY 1
